index.notice: Screens are filters applied to the companies' filed statements. A company listed meets the stated condition on the figures shown; it is not a recommendation.

screens.name: Four quarters of 20%+ revenue growth
screens.rule: Revenue up more than 20% on the same quarter a year earlier, in each of the last four quarters.

screens.name: Back to profit
screens.rule: A profit after tax in the latest quarter, against a loss in the same quarter a year earlier.

screens.name: Operating margin up 3 points or more
screens.rule: Operating margin at least 3 percentage points above the same quarter a year earlier, with revenue also higher.

screens.name: More cash than debt, and profitable
screens.rule: Cash and current investments above total borrowings on the latest balance sheet, and a profit after tax in the latest full year.

screens.name: Three years of free cash flow
screens.rule: Free cash flow positive in each of the last three full years, and operating cash flow above profit after tax in the latest one.
